newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Petkoff says June inflation under 3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Petkoff says June inflation under 3 pct.

text.p: Venezuela's Planning Minister Teodoro Petkoff said June's inflation rate, officially due out later today, would be under three percent, compared to 3.1 percent in May.
"The inflation for this month should be a little less than three percent," Petkoff told Union Radio in an interview.
The monthly inflation rate in June 1996 was 7.1 percent.
Petkoff said a sub-three percent inflation rate in June would bring the cumulative rate over the first half of the year to about 15 percent -- in line with government targets.
"The goal for this year of between 30 and 35 percent looks more and more plausible each month," he said.
Central Bank President Antonio Casas Gonzalez has said that if the cumulative rate can be kept to 15 percent over the first six months, the annual rate should be around 30 percent.
The Central Bank was due to release the official monthly inflation rate late this afternoon.
